reasons.cache: The 1-hour Rails cache of the price lookups, keyed on the filters' last update: Tanvo computes each lookup per query from the current filters, which a query reads in the same transaction as the plan, so a lookup is never stale (parity §1.42).
reasons.order-by: The order_by parameter of the service, which neither the REST controller nor the GraphQL resolver passes: the basis orders (amount on the amount basis, events count otherwise), and the API has no order_by (parity §1.42).
reasons.feature-flag: The account_tree feature flag: Tanvo has no feature flags (parity §1.50); the query is available wherever the organization's events are in the ClickHouse store.
reasons.page: The page-number meta of the REST response: the API pages with opaque page tokens and returns total_size, the number of values (parity §1.42).
